backend/servers/api-server/src/services/scheduler/mod.rs:262-288 — BackgroundScheduler::start() runs a single tokio::spawn'd `loop { ticker.tick().await; self.run_scheduled_tasks().await; }` with no per-tick panic isolation (no catch_unwind, no supervisor/restart). backend/servers/api-server/src/services/scheduler/mod.rs:276 — `interval(Duration::from_secs(self.config.interval_secs))` (default 60s, mod.rs:81) uses tokio's default MissedTickBehavior::Burst and is never reconfigured (grep for MissedTickBehavior across services/ returns zero hits). If a single run_scheduled_tasks() exceeds the 60s interval under load (it awaits ~16 sequential DB-backed tasks, several fanning out notifications), Burst makes the ticker immediately fire the backlog of missed ticks back-to-back, producing a burst of overlapping-cadence maintenance runs instead of a steady 60s cadence. backend/servers/api-server/src/services/oauth.rs:945-946 — verify_pkce (fn at oauth.rs:939) computes `let computed = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(sha256(verifier))` then returns `computed == challenge`, a non-constant-time String equality on a security-sensitive comparison.
